meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: Claude 会去搜索你在 Claude-Mem(cmem.ai)上的持久记忆——由你各 agent 过去会话合成的带时间戳观察记录。它先用宽泛关键词检索,再逐步收窄,最后用大白话把相关记录综合成答案,而不是把原始搜索结果丢给你。
howto.when: 当你说「搜索记忆」「你还记得 X 吗」等,或想找某个项目、决定、文件、任务的过往会话上下文时触发。

say.text: 搜索记忆:上次我们是怎么解决登录报错的?
say.note: 会用关键词检索并综合成答案

say.text: 你还记得这个项目用的是哪个数据库吗?
say.note: 返回带时间戳的相关记录

say.text: 跑一下 cmem-hook status 看看记忆连接是否正常
say.note: 报告 API key 或端点状态

howto.what_en: Claude searches your Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory — timestamped observations from past sessions across your agents. It starts with broad keyword searches, then narrows, and answers in plain language instead of dumping raw output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", or want prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task.

say_en.text: Search memory: how did we fix that login error last time?
say_en.note: Runs a keyword search and synthesizes an answer.

say_en.text: What do you remember about which database this project uses?
Run cmem-hook status to check the memory connection.
say_en.note: Reports API key or endpoint status.
